b.lede: Binance is warning about a vulnerability in Apple's iOS 26.7.1, 27.0.1, and 27.2 that could allow third-party apps to read private files stored by other apps, including cryptocurrency seed phrases, secret keys, and login credentials. [...]
b.title: Binance warns of iOS flaw that could leak crypto wallet secrets
